claimProduct(uint256).details: Called when consumer scans QR and claims the product      Different from transfer — this is the initial claim from brand to consumer

returns.metadataHash: SHA-256 hash of the product metadata
returns.mintedAt: Timestamp when the product was minted
returns.mintedBy: Admin address that minted the product

mintToBlockchain(string,string).details: Called by API server after admin signs via MetaMask      Flow: Admin Form → API generates UUID + SHA-256 hash → MetaMask sign → this function

returns._0: tokenId     Auto-incremented token ID yang di-assign ke NFT

transferProduct(uint256,address).details: Called when consumer transfers NFT (preloved/resale)      Consumer signs via MetaMask → Smart Contract executes transfer

verifyProduct(uint256).details: Read-only function called during QR scan verification flow      The API server recomputes the hash from MySQL metadata and compares

returns.currentOwner: Current owner address of the NFT
returns.mintedAt: Timestamp when the product was minted
returns.mintedBy: Admin who originally minted this product
